header.district_office: District Civil Administration & Document Verification Portal

home.badge: District Governance • Secure OCR Architecture v1.0
home.title: Document Processing & OCR Verification System
home.subtitle: Official district-level administrative platform for rapid extraction, validation, and tamper-evident verification of civil status certificates, birth records, and administrative documents.

features.zdr_desc: Citizen identity buffers are securely zeroized from volatile memory immediately after inference. Zero persistent storage of civil documents.
features.accuracy_desc: High-fidelity OCR model optimized for official Khmer administrative typography (Kantumruy) and Latin certificate records.
features.tamper_desc: SHA-256 ephemeral fingerprint verification detects document tampering without exposing citizen Personally Identifiable Information.

upload.title: Document Pre-Flight Quality Gate
upload.subtitle: Upload civil registration document (Birth Certificate, National ID) for pre-flight quality verification and OCR alignment.
upload.dropzone_title: Drag & drop document here, or browse file
upload.dropzone_hint: Supports PNG, JPEG, and PDF documents up to 15 MB
upload.processing: Evaluating document sharpness, exposure, and readability in volatile RAM...
upload.quality_error_message: This file has quality issues (blur, dark, or incomplete). Please retake the photo.

verification.title: Civil Registration Document Verification & Alignment
verification.subtitle: Interactive bounding box alignment and side-by-side municipal database cross-referencing.
verification.manual_review_warning: One or more fields have discrepancies or similarity below 85%. Please review and verify each highlighted field before approval.
verification.verified_success: All extracted fields match municipal civil registry records (confidence >= 85%). Minor OCR misreadings have been auto-corrected.

actions.export_success: Document successfully approved! Local verification report downloaded.
